opinions.note: IISD’s Earth Negotiations Bulletin reports that the proposed Antalya Pact cover decisions were not adopted at the November 22 closing plenary, confirming that no cover decision was adopted by the November 21 deadline.
At the November 22 closing plenary, the UNFCCC Executive Secretary confirmed that neither presidency-led cover decision had been agreed, so neither was adopted by the November 21 deadline.
The COP31 conference extended into overtime past the Saturday 21 November 23:59 deadline and ultimately closed on Sunday 22 November 2026 without adopting an overarching Presidency cover decision.

On 20 November 2026, Public Administration Minister Paolo Zangrillo stated that public-sector participation in the CGIL general strike was just under 12% (corresponding to the 11.98% provisional GEPAS report from the Department of Public Administration at 18:30/18:45), which is not below 10.0%.
ANSA reported Zangrillo’s evening national public-sector figure as just under 12%, consistent with the Department’s provisional GEPAS rate of 11.98%, above the 10.0% cutoff.
The Ukrainian Air Force’s first overnight summary reported 148 drones launched from 18:00 Kyiv time on November 20, with three ballistic missiles counted separately.
JMIC Advisory Update 116 confirms that two merchant tankers, TORKEL and ARINA, were struck by projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on November 21, 2026.
The French Interior Ministry reported 82.5 thousand demonstrators nationwide on November 21, 2026, including 21.5 thousand in Paris.

Carbon Brief reports that no cover decision was adopted by the 23:59 Saturday 21 November 2026 deadline, as the third draft cover decision was only published at 03:00 local time on Sunday 22 November (and ultimately failed to be adopted at all).

UKMTO issued Warnings 215-26 and 216-26 reporting two separate projectile hits on tankers transiting outbound in the Strait of Hormuz on 21 November 2026 at 05:00 UTC (09:00 GST) and 05:50 UTC (09:50 GST).
The French Interior Ministry published a national count of 82.5 thousand demonstrators (82,500 people, including 21,500 in Paris) across 112 actions on Saturday, November 21, 2026.
The ONS first reported October 2026 public sector net borrowing excluding public sector banks (PSNB ex, series J5II) as a £17.0 billion deficit.
DG ECFIN’s November 20 flash release reported a November 2026 euro-area consumer confidence balance of −16.9 points.
The ONS published 'Public sector finances, UK: October 2026' on 20 November 2026, reporting public sector net borrowing excluding public sector banks (series J5II) in October 2026 at £17.0 billion.
The rating history shows Moody’s UK sovereign rating unchanged at Aa3 with a stable outlook through November 21, 2026, and no qualifying action was reported in the window.
The B.C. government release reports that the new cabinet was sworn in on November 20 and lists 24 ministers and ministers of state, excluding the premier and parliamentary secretaries.
On 20 November 2026, the European Commission (DG ECFIN) published the November 2026 flash consumer confidence indicator at -16.9 points for the euro area (and -16.5 points for the EU).

On 20 November 2026, Moody's Ratings published an Announcement of Periodic Review titled 'Moody's Ratings announces completion of a periodic review of ratings of United Kingdom, Government of' without announcing any rating action or change to its Aa3 rating or stable outlook.

The Ukrainian Air Force reported that Russia launched 148 drones (including 87 jet-powered Shaheds, Gerbera, and Parodiya decoys) and three ballistic missiles overnight from 18:00 on November 20 to the morning of November 21, 2026, which is fewer than the 150 drones threshold.

The official BC Gov News release announces that Premier Lorne Doerkson's new cabinet was sworn in on November 20, 2026, consisting of 24 members besides the premier (18 ministers and 6 ministers of state).

The NRO and SpaceX confirm that the Falcon 9 carrying the NROL-136 mission lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base on Sunday, November 22, 2026 at 4:23 a.m. PST (7:23 a.m. EST), which was after the event window closed at 23:59 PST on Saturday, November 21, 2026.
Spaceflight Now reports that the Falcon 9 carrying NROL-136 lifted off from Vandenberg at 4:23 a.m. Pacific time on Sunday, November 22, 2026, after the window closed.
